committee_papers.note: Committee id confirmed by the Modern.gov web service (GetCommittees) on 2026-09-26. No committee document downloaded.

quirks.summary: Every page first redirects to /Disclaimer?returnUrl=...; the form is an empty POST to /Disclaimer/Accept?returnUrl=<path>, which sets an AcceptedDisclaimer cookie.
quirks.workaround: POST the disclaimer once (empty body, Content-Length: 0) and keep the cookie jar, as in Recipe A's Somerset variant.

quirks.detail: A results grep for '?applicationNumber=' finds nothing, so a search that returned results reads as empty. The 2026-09-16 survey recorded 'returned nothing' for July 2026 here; a received-date search for 1-7 August 2026 returned 11 results.
quirks.workaround: Grep /Planning/Display[^"]+ without assuming the query-string form.

pacing.note: Seven requests at 5 s spacing on 2026-09-26 with no 429 or challenge.

verification.note: Landing-page survey 2026-09-16: HTTP 200; redirected to https://planningregister.crawley.gov.uk/Disclaimer?returnUrl=%2FSearch%2FAdvanced%2F/; vendor confirmed by fingerprint (def-atrium)
Recipe A: search worked but returned nothing for 1-31 July 2026. Not a retrieval failure.

Recipe A end-to-end: disclaimer accepted by empty POST -> /Search/Advanced token -> POST /Search/Results with SearchPlanning and DateReceivedFrom/To 01/08/2026-07/08/2026 -> 11 results, detail links in path form -> CR/2026/0474/FUL detail page with 6 /Document/Download links -> one file with the session: 189,724 bytes, %PDF-1.7, one page with extractable text, no rate-limit, permission or unavailable notice. Dropped the 'vendor-unverified' quirk (the portal fingerprints as Atrium and a download is verified). Modern.gov GetCommittees checked for the committee id.
